sections.content: Report from dashboard: Blocking transactions. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
select distinct   TO_CHAR(to_timestamp(start_time::bigint / 1000 ), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "start time" from monitoring.v_blocking_transactions
order by TO_CHAR(to_timestamp(start_time::bigint / 1000 ), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
